name: no instance reads the default home

want.label: default
want.validate_routing:
ATTN_INSTANCE=default disagrees with the routing this process resolved.
  instance default is $HOME/.attn (port 9849), but:
    ATTN_CONFIG_PATH = $ROOT/empty.json
  An explicit override outranks ATTN_INSTANCE, so this process would act as instance default against another instance's data. Refusing before anything opens it.
  Fix: env -u ATTN_CONFIG_PATH ATTN_INSTANCE=default <command>
  Or clear them in your shell: eval "$(attn instance-env default)"

  Or clear them in your shell: eval "$(attn instance-env corpus-x9)"
